properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-10-30, relaying an X post (text as he pasted it; the interview itself not read here): "Terence Tao has a troubling question about AI and mathematics. What if we solve the greatest problems but lose the discoveries we would have made along the way? In a new Science Friday interview, the Fields Medalist discusses AI's extraordinary progress on difficult mathematical problems, including Navier–Stokes. ... Years of attempting a problem can produce new techniques, unexpected connections, and mathematical ideas useful far beyond the original question. An AI might produce the final theorem in hours. But what becomes of the mathematics that would have been discovered during the search?" And a reply in the same post (attributed to "the Wren"): "that is a design choice ... hard-wiring provenance into the benchmark: preserve the branches explored, failed approaches, assumptions tested, unexpected connections and reusable methods—and stamp every source that changed the direction of the search, recording what it changed and where the path turned. Knowledge is not power. Structured knowledge is: knowledge with provenance, relationships, failures and paths that others can inspect and build upon. I see failure as an asset. A recorded failure narrows the space for everyone who follows. ... A solved theorem closes one question. A preserved search opens many more." Anthony: "I think both of these go a long way in the direction of using reflow2."

WHAT IS ALREADY HERE: from Tao's views on 2026-10-22 (dec:idea-what-reflow2-takes-from-taos-views-on-ai-in-mathematics), five ideas kept OPEN: (A) a line of reasoning read back as an exposition, (B) a source says what kind of support it gives, (C) an ablation of premises, (D) a failed route as a record of its own, (E) a change discloses its model. The open idea that an agent works a hole by writing every try down (dec:idea-an-agent-works-one-proof-hole-at-a-time-and-writes-every-try-down) depends on (D). Increment 5 already names its likely outcome as "a better map of failed routes". Speculative links are labelled and only the person accepts them. Every write is server-stamped and credited; sources are artifacts with checksums.

WHAT THE POST ADDS: the search itself, not the theorem, as what is kept and judged; and two record kinds nothing names yet: the TURNING POINT (a source or result that changed the direction, what it changed, where the path turned) and the REUSABLE METHOD (a technique found in the search, recorded so it can be applied beyond the problem).

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) PROMOTE (D) BEFORE INCREMENT 5: a failed route is a record (tried, fails at this step, for this reason), so increment 5's search is kept as structure, not prose.
(b) A TURNING POINT IS A RECORD: the strategy change is a Decision, CAUSED by the source or result that forced it, naming the route it left and the route it took.
(c) A REUSABLE METHOD IS A RECORD: a technique the search produced, stated apart from the problem, with where it worked, where it failed, and where else it might apply (a speculative link, labelled).
(d) SCORE THE SEARCH, NOT ONLY THE ANSWER: increment 5 reports how many routes were recorded with their reason, how many turning points name their cause, how many methods were stated apart from the problem; and a fresh reader, from the design alone, restates the search (ties to (A)).
(e) MAKE THE SEARCH TRANSFERABLE: the worked hole's design is published read-only so others can inspect and build on it (math is not private the way a person's design is).

PUSHBACK, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
- RECORDING EVERYTHING IS THE NOTES PROBLEM AGAIN. Increment 8 measured that structure helps only when the reader is cued to it; a search with 200 failed routes nobody can find is a pile. The records must be findable and ranked, not merely kept.
- UNEXPECTED CONNECTIONS ARE RARELY SEEN AT THE TIME. A person often recognises them years later. What can be kept now is the raw material: the route, the obstacle, the method; a connection is then a speculative link someone proposes later.
- AN AGENT CAN DRESS UP NOTHING AS A METHOD. A "reusable method" the agent names is a claim; it stays claimed until it is used again somewhere and works (the gates accepted today apply: the record, not the report).
- MUCH OF THIS EXISTS IN PIECES (sources, decisions, CAUSES, stamps, speculative links); the gain is naming the turning point and the method, and scoring the search.

COST (a finding): (d) small, it is protocol for increment 5; (e) small; (b) small, a Decision with a CAUSES edge from a source, mostly a skill's wording; (a) moderate, a record kind and its read-back; (c) moderate.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-30 — the preserved search is a deliverable of working a proof hole: failed routes become records first (a), turning points name their cause (b), and increment 5 is scored on its search (d); reusable-method records (c) and publishing the search (e) stay considered
properties.rationale:
Anthony relayed Terence Tao's concern (solving the problem may lose the mathematics found during the search) and a reply proposing that the search itself be preserved with provenance. It lands directly on increment 5 of the cognition-plus-memory plan and on idea (D) from Tao's earlier views. Recorded as the open part: whether the preserved search is a deliverable and how it is scored.
